title: Computer Algebra System Bundle
description: Create mathematical/cas: a full-blown headless computer algebra system in pure Rust, consumed over its Rust API. Implement intermediate general-purpose crates mathematical/number (arbitrary precision, number theory, abstract algebra traits) and mathematical/polynomial (generic uni/multivariate polynomials, factorization, Groebner bases, root isolation), extend mathematical/algebra with generic exact linear algebra, and build the mathematical_cas kernel (expression representation, canonicalization, assumptions, pattern matching) plus domains: simplify, calculus (diff/integrate/limits/series), solve, symbolic matrices, ODEs, special functions, transforms, PDEs, quantifier elimination, tensor calculus, units, numeric evaluation. Zero external dependencies, matching the mathematical/* purity precedent.
